title: iTutorGroup automated age screening
system_purpose: Filter applications for remote tutoring roles
decision_impact: Automatic rejection prevented applicants from advancing to review
verified_facts: EEOC alleged that configured software automatically rejected women aged 55 or older and men aged 60 or older.
quantitative_evidence: More than 200 qualified applicants were rejected; settlement relief was $365000.
limitations: The EEOC settlement describes allegations and relief but publishes no technical audit of the underlying software.

title: Amazon experimental recruiting model
decision_impact: Model recommendations influenced which candidates received recruiter attention
verified_facts: Reuters reported that Amazon developed a resume-ranking tool from 2014 and scrapped it in 2018 after it downgraded resumes containing women-focused language.
quantitative_evidence: Reporting gives dates but no affected-applicant count or deployed-decision rate.
limitations: This was a reported experimental tool rather than a regulator finding of a deployed discriminatory decision system.

title: Workday AI screening discrimination lawsuit
system_purpose: Screen and rank job applicants for employers
decision_impact: Automated screening shaped which applicants advanced to interviews
verified_facts: Reuters reported that a job applicant sued Workday and alleged its AI screening tools discriminated on race age and disability grounds.
quantitative_evidence: The complaint alleges systemic adverse impact but no court ruling or quantified harm figure is public.
limitations: The claim is an unresolved allegation in litigation; no merits ruling or independent audit is available.
